entities.name: Geraldo João Martins
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Geraldo João Martins is a Bissau-Guinean economist and politician who served as Prime Minister of Guinea-Bissau in 2023, and is the vice president of the African Party for the Independence of Guinea and Cape Verde. Prior to his tenure as prime minister he worked at the World Bank and was the Minister of Education and Minister of Economy and Finance.
